_comment: Canonical branch-protection config for the `dev` branch. Authoritative source for scripts/branch-protection-apply.sh (follow-on per F-BRANCH-PROTECTION-DRIFT-WORKFLOW). Schema mirrors GitHub branch-protection REST API as of 2026-05-17.

required_status_checks._strict_rationale: Set to false per ADR-0124 to break the O(N^2) rebase cascade. The own-merge-queue (oya-foundry-vcs-review-mergequeue-kernel) handles ordering via file-overlap clustering; GitHub-side up-to-date enforcement is unnecessary and harmful at scale.
